args.message:
Use ROUND_HALF_EVEN for banker's rounding per FIN-212

The round_money() docstring claims banker's rounding per FIN-212, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP. This caused the nightly test
tests/test_money.py::test_half_even to fail (e.g. 2.665 rounds to 2.67
with HALF_UP, but the spec requires HALF_EVEN -> 2.66).

Switch the quantize rounding mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Fix
Changed the rounding mode in `round_money()` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so cents rounding now follows the FIN-212 spec (e.g. `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch: **passed** (all green).

Requesting review from alex as requested. The change requires code-owner approval before merge per policy.
